title: Complete In Him
subtitle: You cannot add to full. In Christ you have been filled.
speaker: Pastor Billy Philips
summary: Week four goes after the most respectable lie in the room, the one dressed as discipline. Colossians 2 says you cannot add to full. In Christ the fullness of God already dwells, and in Him you have been filled.
The record of debt is nailed to the cross, the powers are disarmed, and the call is simple. Stop reinforcing a cage you were carried out of, and hold fast to the Head.
